description: A golden set for reference-library retrieval. Without measurement, no retrieval change is verifiable — a reranking tweak that helps three queries and quietly breaks five looks identical to one that helps all eight.
how_embeddings_are_built: Each chunk names a semantic cluster. Every chunk in a cluster gets the same base vector plus small deterministic jitter, so cosine similarity inside a cluster is high and between clusters is low. This reproduces the property that makes this corpus hard: the discriminating token is the only thing separating two chunks an embedding considers nearly identical. The vectors are generated, not stored, so the fixture stays readable.

corpus.text: AS9100D certification is required of the supplier for all flight hardware deliveries under this agreement. The certificate shall remain valid for the full term.
First article inspection shall be performed and reported in accordance with AS9102 for every new part number and after any process change.
NADCAP accreditation is required for heat treating and for non-destructive testing performed by any subcontractor.
A quality management system conforming to ISO 9001:2015 shall be maintained and audited annually by an accredited registrar.
Under GAFTA 48 the weight ascertained at the port of loading shall be final, save for manifest error, and the weighing certificate shall accompany the documents.
Under GAFTA 49 the weight is determined at discharge, and any dispute over the weighing shall be referred to arbitration.
The Canadian Grain Commission requires that official samples be drawn during loading and retained for the statutory period.
Ti-6Al-4V in the annealed condition shall meet a minimum ultimate tensile strength of 895 MPa and 10 percent elongation.
Inconel 718 in the solution treated and aged condition shall meet a minimum ultimate tensile strength of 1240 MPa.
7075-T6 aluminium shall meet a minimum ultimate tensile strength of 524 MPa and shall not be used above 150 degrees Celsius.
Payment shall be made against presentation of documents within three banking days of receipt, by telegraphic transfer in the contract currency.
Where an irrevocable letter of credit is opened, it shall be confirmed by a first class bank and shall be available by sight payment.

queries.why: The discriminating token is the standard number. An embedding reads AS9100D, AS9102 and a generic quality-systems paragraph as near-identical content about aerospace quality.
The neighbouring standard is the trap: the two differ by one character that carries the whole meaning.

queries.query: GAFTA 48 weighing at port of loading
queries.why: Contract numbers. 48 and 49 describe opposite rules for the same subject.
Alloy designations. Every chunk in the cluster states a tensile minimum; only the designation separates them.
As above, from the other side, so a fix that merely reorders the cluster does not pass.

queries.query: when is payment due after documents are presented
queries.why: A control. The query shares almost no exact tokens with the chunk, so a change that helps only lexical matching must not break this one.

queries.query: what kind of bank must confirm the credit
queries.why: A second control, phrased as a question rather than keywords.
